question: Ajay starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards North. He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 12 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 6 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Ajay starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards North.

He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 12 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 6 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cccdc110cbcd3f83c0e7282543992798ea25076afc5d36566783299b3a03d39.png] 

So, He should drive **3 km to east** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
